snippet.title: Haunted Paws - Demo Launch & Consoles Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Haunted Paws: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861080/Haunted_Paws/

Haunted Paws is coming to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S! 

A free demo for the cozy and spooky co-op adventure is also available now on Steam. Create your own puppies, explore a haunted mansion, solve puzzles together, and rescue your missing owner from the monsters lurking within.

Haunted Paws Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861080/Haunted_Paws/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10086301
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/haunted-paws/9N00W4FPCJ2V

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
